scope: Original daily equity action ledger. Explicit zero costs and either full fills or four units per bar isolate position/order/entitlement accounting. No benchmark, migration-completion or general-merger claim.

capture_assumptions.native_publication: The synthetic terms are explicitly declared available at the first captured close, after the original civil declaration date and before the ex session. This is a caller fixture declaration; the original export retains unknown publication as null.
capture_assumptions.currency: The synthetic instruments and cash distributions are explicitly denominated in USD. This declaration is separate from exported unknown currency.
capture_assumptions.share_basis: Cash dividend and stock eligibility uses pre-event shares.
capture_assumptions.prices: Session labels map to captured original physical closes; no implicit timezone or guessed availability.
